articles.title: Red Sox’ Roman Anthony: ‘I feel sick to my stomach’

articles.title: Curtis Mead, sidelined since July with a broken wrist, is now the Red Sox's best hope after Roman Anthony's wrist injury forces a last-minute roster change
articles.description: Curtis Mead, recovering from a broken wrist, was added to the Red Sox playoff roster as a last-minute replacement for Roman Anthony, who was removed due to a wrist injury of his own.
